## Problem statement

What problem does this solve? Who experiences it and how often?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you'd like to see. Include wireframes, API shapes, or examples where helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Scope

Which part of Silo does this touch?

- [ ] API (Go backend)
- [ ] Web frontend (React)
- [ ] Database / migrations
- [ ] Infrastructure / self-hosting
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional context

Anything else — related issues, prior art in similar tools, or links to relevant discussions.
